title: Tab must leave a datepicker input for the next field
status: Found by Tabstitch and reported upstream as twbs/bootstrap#43202 on 2026-10-26 (reduced test case re-checked against the published 6.0.0-alpha.1 bundle and main at d793f282). Reproduced in headless Chromium 156 and desktop Chrome 155.
summary: When the field is reached with Tab, the calendar does not open, but vanilla-calendar-pro treats it as shown: on the next Tab it cancels the key and focuses the first control of a calendar that is not in the page, so focus stays in the date field. Escape is the only way out, and it drops focus to the page body.
expectedBehaviour: With the calendar closed, Tab moves to the next field (WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap). When the calendar is open, for example after a click, Tab moving into it is the library's intended design and is not changed by this task. Escape keeps closing the calendar.
dependencies: dist/css/bootstrap.min.css: the published 6.0.0-alpha.1 stylesheet from npm (MIT)

vendor/vanilla-calendar-pro/index.js: vanilla-calendar-pro 3.4.0 index.mjs from npm (MIT), Bootstrap's peer dependency, mapped with an import map. It is outside the editable source, so a repair has to be made in Bootstrap's TypeScript.
consumer: Author-written booking change form around the unchanged TypeScript source at pinnedCommit, served with types erased by Node's built-in stripping.
